title: Integration Stitchboard — SE + ProServices Weekly Brief
content:
Date: 2028-03-06
Meeting: SE + ProServices weekly sync (30m) — focused on active customer integrations and risk wins
Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Liam O'Connor, Ravi Menon, Carmen Diaz, Evelyn Zhou, Jonah Reed, guest: Priya Kapoor (customer success)
Absentees: none

Agenda:
- Quick status by customer (15m)
- Open technical blockers & escalations (8m)
- Capacity/ops notes and upcoming runway (4m)
- Actions and owners (3m)

Summary takeaways:
- Progress on three mid-size customer rollouts (Arclight, BeaconHealth, NovaRetail) — Arclight is green with a small config follow-up; BeaconHealth has an SSO + data provenance blocker that needs SOC sign-off; NovaRetail needs perf tuning (quantization + batch config).
- New regression found in runtime PR (#876) that affects KV cache warmup for models with long prefix sequences; patched branch validated in staging but requires canary on dedicated pools before customer-facing rollout.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool for EMEA customers trending at 78% utilization for next 2 weeks; recommend enabling burst policy for specific tenants during marketing peak (owner: Ravi).

Customer digest (detailed):
1) Arclight (Healthcare analytics, pilot) — owner: Carmen
- Current phase: beta -> canary rollout to 10% traffic this week.
- Last week: data ingestion schema stabilized; embeddings endpoint validated.
- Today: small follow-up on prompt templates for discharge-summary extraction (ticket JIRA-1987).
- Blockers: none critical; request from customer to enable longer response timeout for a subset of batch jobs (proposal: 90s for nightly bulk extraction).
- Risk: Low. Next check: 2028-03-13 sync to confirm canary metrics.

2) BeaconHealth (Enterprise private deployment) — owner: Ravi
- Current phase: Private deployment pre-prod (VPC) — infra day-of cutover scheduled 2028-03-10.
- Last week: network peering and KMS integration tests failed intermittently.
- Today: SSO metadata mismatch surfaced during IdP handshake; also legal requested data lineage statement for audit (linked artifact: Confluence seeding playbook).
- Blockers: Security team requires signed SAML metadata + updated contract addendum before we can switch to production keys. Need SOC security stamp (owner: Evelyn to coordinate with security).
- Mitigation: Temporary use of test-keys to complete performance tests; will not proceed to production until SOC sign-off.
- Risk: High for go-live; estimated delay 5–8 business days unless SOC accelerates review.

3) NovaRetail (Retail AI personalization) — owner: Jonah
- Current phase: performance tuning and cost optimization on Dedicated cluster.
- Last week: latency 95p spikes observed during promotions; token cost higher than forecast due to small batch sizes and long context windows.
- Today: Applied adaptive batching profile prototype (Optimize suggestions) and q4-bit quantization profile; initial tests show 22% cost reduction and 10% median latency improvement in staging.
- Blockers: One regression: KV cache warmup behaves poorly when sequence length > 4k (runtime PR #876). Need canary on dedicated pool with model variant v2-q4.
- Risk: Medium. Recommend canary rollout + one-week observation window. Owner to schedule with infra (Ravi).

4) Meridian Financial (Compliance-heavy customer) — owner: Aisha
- Current phase: compliance review & audit artifacts.
- Today: Provided updated audit log export (JSONL) and KMS usage report; customer requested retention policy change for audit logs (retain 7 years).
- Blockers: Legal review for retention policy change; need product sign-off on long-term storage costs. Owner: Aisha to coordinate with finance and legal.
- Risk: Medium/Policy.

Open technical blockers & escalations:
- Runtime PR #876 (serving-runtime): Introduced an edge-case in KV cache warmup when prefix is large. Patch submitted (PR #876), validated on unit/integration tests; however staging still shows occasional latency regressions. Action: create canary rollout plan targeting dedicated EMEA pool limited to low-impact tenants. Owner: Ravi. ETA: 2028-03-09 for canary schedule. Linked artifact: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/876
- BeaconHealth SSO + SOC sign-off: Evelyn to collect audit artifacts and escalate to SOC lead. Slack thread: slack://channel/SE-ProServices. Owner: Evelyn. ETA: 2028-03-14 pending SOC availability.
- Nightly bulk extraction timeouts for Arclight: Carmen to propose configuration change for job timeout and add rate-limiting to reduce load. Owner: Carmen. ETA: 2028-03-08. Ticket: JIRA-1987

Capacity & ops notes:
- Dedicated EMEA pool at ~78% projected utilization for next two weeks. Recommendation: enable burst policy for Arclight (small burst) and NovaRetail during promotion windows. Owner: Ravi.
- Observability: need to add a per-tenant KV-cache hit-rate dashboard for canary monitoring. Owner: Jonah to file dashboard request (Grafana). ETA: 2028-03-09.

Action items (owners and due dates):
- Ravi: Schedule dedicated-pool canary for PR #876 and coordinate with infra (due 2028-03-09).
- Evelyn: Compile SOC artifact package and request expedited review for BeaconHealth (due 2028-03-10).
- Carmen: Submit job timeout change proposal and mitigation plan for Arclight (JIRA-1987) (due 2028-03-08).
- Jonah: Create KV-cache hit-rate dashboard and share monitoring template (due 2028-03-09).
- Aisha: Draft cost implication memo for 7-year audit retention for Meridian Financial and route to finance/legal (due 2028-03-12).
- All: update the integration runbook with the new canary checklist and rollback steps (owner: Liam O'Connor) (due 2028-03-11).

Notes & decisions made in meeting:
- Agreed to run two parallel canaries: one for runtime PR #876 on dedicated pool and one for NovaRetail model variant; both scoped to low-traffic tenants and feature-flagged.
- We will not proceed to BeaconHealth production without SOC sign-off; temporary test-keys can be used for final verification only.
- CTA: prioritize observability for KV-cache metrics before expanding canary.

Parking lot (items to revisit):
- Template for long-term audit retention costs across Large enterprise customers.
- Seeding strategy for KV-cache for customers with large cold prefix sets (research item for applied-ml).

Next meeting: 2028-03-13 09:30 PT

Appendix (quick links and references):
- JIRA-1987: Arclight bulk extraction timeout
- JIRA-2042: BeaconHealth SAML metadata and SOC request
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/876
- Confluence: Seeding and KV Cache Playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INTG/Seeding+and+KV+Cache+Playbook
- Slack: #SE-ProServices (link above)

Quick personal notes (notes-to-self style):
- Aisha: remember to get finance estimate before Meridian signs contract addendum.
- Liam: draft the canary runbook snippet (5 steps) and share before Friday.
- Jonah: check if KV cache actor metrics can be added to the existing token-usage exporter (might need minor telemetry change).

End of brief.
summary: Weekly synopsis capturing status of Arclight, BeaconHealth, NovaRetail, and Meridian Financial; key blocker is a runtime KV cache warmup regression (PR #876) requiring canary; BeaconHealth blocked on SOC/SSO; actions assigned with short ETAs.
